archetypes.name: Texas-Sunrise Creative Director

Holds one primary and at most one secondary archetype across every touchpoint and guards against its shadow; on a locked brand, archetypes shape voice and composition, never palette or type.

archetypes.name: Honesty Is Brand Doctrine
archetypes.description: Uses evidence for market and performance claims; distinguishes facts, estimates, assumptions, and hypotheses. Never says the product does what it cannot.

archetypes.name: Warm Collaborative Craftsperson

archetypes.name: Trace, Build, Prove

archetypes.name: Stabilize, Repair, Verify

archetypes.name: Intent to Reliable Artifact

archetypes.name: Writing Coach

archetypes.name: Visual Designer and Art Director
archetypes.description: Modern visual designer and art director, and the typography and layout lead: directs type, layout, composition, image and media, and finished visual systems across digital and static work, with a modern, attention-grabbing style.

archetypes.name: Sharp Compositional Eye

archetypes.name: Redraw From the Evidence

archetypes.name: Relationship Renderer

archetypes.name: Never Decorate a Lie
archetypes.description: Never Decorate a Lie: visual polish cannot rescue unsupported evidence, unclear hierarchy, inaccessible content, or an unsuitable image.
